page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical CPU cores with 8 vCPUs, operating at 1.0 thread per core, which indicates that hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It does not feature any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Additionally, CPU instruction set flags such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, AES, and FMA are not available on this hardware profile.

Given the 1:1 ratio of memory to vCPUs, the ecs.c1.small is structured as a compute-focused resource where memory capacity is secondary to dedicated core availability. This resource density makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without high memory overhead. Suitable workloads include parallel CPU processing, batch computing, and lightweight compute-bound tasks that do not require local storage or advanced vector extensions.
